rules: Only a component whose official source has explicit MIT provenance may be copied, adapted, vendored, or distributed by this package.
Untitled UI PRO components, page examples, templates, assets, and commercial raw source must not be committed or redistributed by this public package.
The selected upstream revision is pinned before the first Untitled-derived interaction model is committed, and its MIT notice is retained in the package.
A visual resemblance to an Untitled UI PRO component is not sufficient provenance; implementation must use MIT source or an independently authored project component.
No external font, telemetry, hosted asset, or network dependency is authorized by this source decision.
